mapper.select: select t.username, t.nickname, t.password, t.enabled, r.authority, uo.organization_id as org_id, t.tenant_id as tenant_id, t.expired_time from la_users t left join la_user_roles ur on ur.username = t.username left join la_roles r on r.authority = ur.authority and r.enabled = 1 left join la_user_organization uo on uo.username = t.username where t.username = #{username}

select t.username, t.nickname, t.password, t.enabled, r.authority, uo.organization_id as orgid, t.tenant_id as tenantId, t.expired_time from la_users t left join la_user_roles ur on ur.username = t.username left join la_roles r on r.authority = ur.authority and r.enabled = 1 left join la_user_organization uo on uo.username = t.username where t.mobile = #{mobile}
select u.username, u.nickname from la_user_roles ur inner join la_users u on u.username = ur.username and ur.authority = #{roleId}

select r.id from la_resources r where r.res_type = 3 and ( exists (select 1 from la_role_resources rr where rr.resource_id = r.id and rr.authority in (select authority from la_user_roles where username = #{username} union select org_r.authority from la_organization_roles org_r inner join la_user_organization uo on org_r.organization_id = uo.organization_id where uo.username = #{username})) or exists (select 1 from la_organization_resources org_res inner join la_user_organization uo on org_res.organization_id = uo.organization_id where org_res.resource_id = r.id and uo.username = #{username}) or exists (select 1 from la_role_resources rr where rr.resource_id = r.id and rr.authority in (select authority from la_user_roles where username = #{username} union select org_r.authority from la_organization_roles org_r inner join la_user_organization uo on org_r.organization_id = uo.organization_id where uo.username = #{username})) )

select distinct lar.permission_id from la_resources r join la_api_resources lar on r.id = lar.resource_id where exists (select 1 from la_role_resources rr where rr.resource_id = r.id and rr.authority in (select authority from la_user_roles where username = #{username} union select org_r.authority from la_organization_roles org_r inner join la_user_organization uo on org_r.organization_id = uo.organization_id where uo.username = #{username})) or exists (select 1 from la_organization_resources org_res inner join la_user_organization uo on org_res.organization_id = uo.organization_id where org_res.resource_id = r.id and uo.username = #{username})

select distinct lar.permission_id from la_resources r join la_api_resources lar on r.id = lar.resource_id where exists (select 1 from la_role_resources rr where rr.resource_id = r.id and rr.authority in (#{username}))
select r.id from la_resources r where r.res_type = 3 and ( exists (select 1 from la_role_resources rr where rr.resource_id = r.id and rr.authority in (#{username})) )
